sloka: गदामादाय सङ्क्रुद्धो मत्तो राक्षसपुङ्गवः।हरीन् समभिदुद्राव युगान्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन् ।। ६.७०.५४ ।।
transliteration: gadāmādāya saṅkruddho matto rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ।harīn samabhidudrāva yugāntāgniriva jvalan ।। 6.70.54 ।।

translations.english: Matta, the Rakshasa leader became very furious and took hold of the mace glowing like fire, at the time of dissolution of the universe and scattered the monkeys.
